verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh is a KYC/AML compliance platform, so a document-plus-selfie identity verification flow is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence covers only sanctions/PEP/adverse-media screening, case management, monitoring, exports and transaction screening. The retrieved OpenAPI schema lists customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources, with no verification-session, document-capture, selfie/liveness or hosted/drop-in SDK capability.
